title: Telephony Message Send Command
description: Imperative request to send a text from one of the operator's Telnyx numbers. The executor answers with telephony.message.sent (accepted) and then telephony.message.completed or telephony.message.failed, carrying this command_id. Telnyx long codes need 10DLC registration to reach US mobiles (error 40010 otherwise). Recommended idempotency_key: 'telephony.message.send:<to>:<sha256(text)>:<minute>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (telephony).

from.description: Sending Telnyx number (E.164); null uses the default line.

media_urls.description: Public URLs to send as MMS.
